# Week 5 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-10-07

## Source and freshness

**Fresh committed fixture, live overlay added nothing new.** `weekly-report-week-5.json` was generated 2026-10-06T16:07:10Z — after Week 4's Monday-night finale and before Week 5's first kickoff (Thursday 10/8) — so it is current, not stale; `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` independently confirms Week 5. Pulled live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 5 anyway, since this is the Wednesday practice-report run. Result: only **19 rows, covering just DAL and TB** (tonight's Thursday game). No other team with a rostered player — NO, IND, NYG, SEA, ATL, CIN, LAC, PHI, LAR, GB, DET, NE — has filed. The one rostered player on a team that has filed, Bucky Irving (TB), has no row at all — confirms the fixture's "Healthy" tag, adds nothing new. Marked `isLive: false` because the one thing this run exists to surface — a fresh Wednesday practice bucket — is not there yet for the one flagged player on this roster.

## Practice report

**Empty for this roster.** The only Questionable player on the team is **Tee Higgins (WR, CIN, groin)**, and Cincinnati has not filed a Week 5 report. His DNP/Limited/Full bucket is unknown; the fixture's 0.884 P(play) is a carryover, not a fresh signal. For context, league-wide history splits Questionable players sharply by bucket: **DNP ~0.511, Limited ~0.702, Full ~0.790**, against 0.694 overall — worth re-pulling the moment CIN files, expected Thursday or Friday.

No other rostered player carries a designation that needs a practice bucket. Jaxson Dart (IR, season-ending knee) doesn't get a fresh weekly report because he's already out for the year. Jalen Coker (Out, quad) is on Carolina's Week 5 bye anyway, so his status doesn't matter this week either way.

## Start these ten

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | vs MIN | 17.28 | 96.5% | 17.91 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @PIT | 17.39 | 94.5% | 18.41 |

| WR | Drake London | vs BAL | 16.39 | 96.3% | 17.02 |

| FLEX | Tee Higgins (Q) | @MIA | 13.66 | 88.4% | 15.45 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | @DAL (Thu) | 13.73 | 94.5% | 14.54 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs DEN | 7.69 | 98.3% | 7.82 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @JAX | 4.15 | 100% | 4.15 |
| **Total** | | | **136.29** | | |

Bench: Matthew Stafford (17.94, QB), Matthew Golden (12.02, WR), Jameson Williams (11.30, WR), TreVeyon Henderson (7.62, RB), Jalen Coker (Out/bye, WR). IR: Jaxson Dart.

## Changes since Monday

**No lineup changes.** The roster and starting lineup are unchanged from the 2026-10-05 Monday briefing. Two swaps were checked on the fixture's own numbers and both were held:

- **Stafford (17.94) over Shough (17.28) at QB** — a +0.66 edge, favoring the bench QB. Held: Shough stays, since a gap this size is well inside the model's own measured error and Shough's three straight 22-24 point actual starts (the reason he was started in the first place) aren't a reason to flip on this margin.
- **Golden (12.02) over Skattebo (11.46) at FLEX** — a +0.56 edge. Held for the same reason: smaller than the noise.

Neither is a real signal on a model with backtested RMSE of several points per player-week and pairwise start/sit accuracy around 0.72–0.73. Recorded here so it isn't silently relitigated next run without new information.

## Still uncertain

- **Tee Higgins' practice bucket.** Questionable/groin, but CIN hasn't filed. If Thursday or Friday's report shows a DNP, his real P(play) likely drops below the fixture's 0.884 (DNP-designated Questionables play at ~0.511 historically) — re-open the FLEX call then. A Full practice would instead push him close to a normal start.
- **The QB and FLEX margins above** — not expected to resolve with more data this week, flagged as a standing "don't chase this gap" note rather than an open question.

## Opponent notes

- **NYG @ WAS (Sun 1pm)** is a two-player stack: Skattebo (RB) and Likely (TE) are both Giants, so one bad Giants game script costs two of the ten starting slots simultaneously.
- **Eagles D/ST plays the early London game @ JAX (Sun 9:30am ET)** — kicks off before every other game on the slate. Nothing about JAX's current form changes the start call.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 5 (this week):** Jalen Coker (CAR) — bench player, no lineup impact.
- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN) and Jameson Williams (DET) — the current FLEX starter and the best bench WR body out at once, flagged in every briefing since 2026-09-28 and still not resolved. Matthew Golden is the only healthy WR depth left if both are out. Needs a waiver add before Week 6.
- **Week 7:** Cameron Dicker (LAC) — only rostered kicker; a streaming add will be needed that week.
